question: Who was appointed chief executive of Brunnhal Energy Cooperative?

T.title: Energy cooperative names new chief
T.text: Marit Solvang has been appointed chief executive of Brunnhal Energy Cooperative, which owns wind turbines and solar fields serving member households across the valley. The cooperative's board said she would lead plans to add battery storage at the Granholm substation and expand membership in nearby towns.

P.title: Brunnhal cooperative appoints chief executive
P.text: Brunnhal Energy Cooperative has appointed Dmitri Helland as its chief executive. The cooperative owns wind turbines and solar fields that serve member households across the valley, and its board said he would oversee plans for battery storage at the Ostervik substation and wider membership in nearby towns.

F1.title: Farmers lease land for solar fields
F1.text: Several farmers in the valley have leased fields to the Brunnhal Energy Cooperative for solar panels, saying the rent provides a steady income alongside grazing. Sheep continue to graze between the panel rows, which farmers say keeps the grass short. The cooperative also pays for fencing and gate repairs on leased land.

F2.title: How to join the cooperative
F2.text: Households in the valley can join Brunnhal Energy Cooperative by buying a membership share, which gives them a vote at annual meetings. Members receive updates on new projects and can attend open days at the wind turbines and solar fields during the summer. Membership forms are available online.
